description: Whether the directory lists hotels in a place, and how many, without returning listings. Use when the user asks if a destination is covered, or before planning a trip around one. Deepest in the US and Western Europe, thin in China, the Gulf and much of Africa; an uncovered place comes back with covered places instead.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, if known.

place.description: City, region or country to check.

name: check_coverage

km.description: Distance from the place asked about, when it could be located.

title: Check directory coverage
